messages.subject: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020): revised packages for 2027
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for agreeing to the 1500 ppm target and for your revised offer.

The forecast for part:310020 increased by 20% (fc:310020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

The attached packages cover 15900 pieces per year over a 12-month contract from 2027-01-01. This gives your plant a steady, plannable load. Two packages pair a tighter ppm commitment with a different price, so you can choose the quality level your process can hold reliably. That keeps your scrap and rework workload predictable.

Which of these packages could you sign? We would also welcome any cheaper casting or machining variants you can suggest for this bracket.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
